verdict: A two-day Meta outage cut leads in half; ads are back running.
narrative: Lead volume dropped 48% week-over-week because Meta stopped delivering on August 6–7, producing zero spend and zero leads across both days. Prior to the outage, the campaign was performing normally — August 2–4 delivered 8 leads on $248 in spend before activity went to zero. Ads have been restarted and the outage is confirmed as the sole driver of the spike in cost per lead, which rose 38% as a result. Separately, 62 contacts arrived through the pipeline this period but none progressed to tracked opportunities or appointments, and we are auditing that intake process now to ensure no leads are falling through. With the outage resolved, lead volume should normalize in the coming week.
